chore(pstack): sync page-stop's render-first fix from dotai fb7c4d1

page-stop wrote the page before rendering it, so a stage the renderer refused left files that made the next stage send nothing. It now renders first, and a refused stage or stop leaves the page folder untouched. The babysit plan closes with its reflect.

Claude Code sessions publish plan pages through page-stop. Codex sessions publish nothing, so they see no change.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-10-31-pr-5239-babysit.md
Beyond the ask: the reflect run the close rules require, and the page-stop fix reflect applies without waiting
